definition.name: Create U Stairs From Runs
definition.description: Creates U-shaped stairs between two levels from two straight run paths and a rectangular half landing (mm).
definition.aiDescription: Creates U-shaped stairs between two levels from two straight run paths and a rectangular half landing (mm). Runs with manual transactions (its own transactions and edit scopes, one undo step).
examples: Build Stairs 5 and 6 in Block C (U-shaped, 2 x 8 risers of 212.5 mm, 250 going, 1198 wide, half landing) from Level 2 to Level 3, and delete any empty leftovers from the diagnostic run.
definition.author: mrafaatFK2S3
